import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp")
from harness import *

# ---------------- Call-ID / CSeq / Content-Length / Privacy ----------------
check("callid ok chars", run(batch([job(raw=req(callid="aA0_.@+-x"))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("callid space", run(batch([job(raw=req(callid="a b"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("callid 129", run(batch([job(raw=req(callid="a"*129))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("callid 128", run(batch([job(raw=req(callid="a"*128))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("callid empty", run(batch([job(raw=req(callid=""))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cseq no ws", run(batch([job(raw=req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 9MESSAGE"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cseq tab ok", run(batch([job(raw=req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 9\t\tMESSAGE"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[4], "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE")
check("cseq lower method", run(batch([job(raw=req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 9 message"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cseq wrong method", run(batch([job(raw=req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 9 INVITE"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cseq zero", run(batch([job(raw=req(cseq="0"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cseq 0000", run(batch([job(raw=req(cseq="0000"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cseq max", run(batch([job(raw=req(cseq="2147483647"))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("cseq over max", run(batch([job(raw=req(cseq="2147483648"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cseq huge", run(batch([job(raw=req(cseq="9"*30))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cseq plus", run(batch([job(raw=req(cseq="+9"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cl mismatch", run(batch([job(raw=req(cl="4"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cl leading zeros ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(cl="0005"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[-2], "Content-Length: 5")
check("cl empty", run(batch([job(raw=req(cl=""))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cl plus", run(batch([job(raw=req(cl="+5"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("cl zero body ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(body="", cl="0"))]))[0]["wire"].endswith("\r\n\r\n"), True)
check("privacy ID ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("Privacy: ID",)))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[5], "Privacy: id")
check("privacy none ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("Privacy: none",)))]))[0]["private"], False)
check("privacy bad", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("Privacy: id, none",)))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("privacy empty", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("Privacy:",)))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("ctype empty", run(batch([job(raw=req(ctype=""))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("ctype htab kept", run(batch([job(raw=req(ctype="text/plain\t;x=1"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[6], "Content-Type: text/plain\t;x=1")
check("ctype no body ct ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(ctype=None))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[6], "Content-Length: 5")

# ---------------- From/To tags ----------------
check("tag ws around", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>\t;\ttag\t=\t q7 ")]))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("tag empty", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag="))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("tag 129", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=" + "a"*129))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("tag 128 ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=" + "a"*128))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("tag other param", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;foo=x"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("tag double", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=a;tag=b"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("tag dup semis", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;;tag=a"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("tag name case", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;TAG=q7"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("tag tagx", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tagx=q7"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("tag trailing text", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7z z"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("tag on to kept", run(batch([job(raw=req(to="<sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=T1"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[2], "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=T1")
check("to no tag omitted", run(batch([job(raw=req(to="<sip:inbox@relay.test>"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[2], "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>")
check("bare uri with tag", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test;tag=q7"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("bare uri ws tag", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test ; tag = q7"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("bare uri only", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>")
check("two addrs from", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>, <sip:desk@sales.test>"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("stray after >", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test>x"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("empty address", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<>"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("empty address ws", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<   >"))])), [rej("syntax")])

# ---------------- display names ----------------
check("disp token ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="Bob <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("disp multi token", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="Bob A. Smith <sip:ember@studio.test>"))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("disp nospace", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="Bob<sip:ember@studio.test>"))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("disp quoted ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"A, B" <sip:ember@studio.test>'))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("disp quoted nospace", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"A,B"<sip:ember@studio.test>'))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("disp quoted escape", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"q \\" <sip:x@y.tld> ;" <sip:ember@studio.test>'))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("disp quoted htab", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"a\tb" <sip:ember@studio.test>'))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("disp unterminated", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"abc <sip:ember@studio.test>'))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("disp dangling escape", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"abc\\" <sip:ember@studio.test>'))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("disp quoted then junk", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"a"b <sip:ember@studio.test>'))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("disp quoted no addr", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"abc"'))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("disp token no addr", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="Bob"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("disp mixed token+quote", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='a "b" <sip:ember@studio.test>'))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("disp colon not token", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:a@b.c <sip:ember@studio.test>"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("nested brackets", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:ember@studio.test<x>"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("double brackets", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<<sip:ember@studio.test>>"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("inner ws brackets", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<\tsip:ember@studio.test\t>"))]))[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>")
check("disp quote contains lt", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"a<b" <sip:ember@studio.test>'))]))[0]["status"], "accept")
check("disp quote contains gt", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm='"a>b" <sip:ember@studio.test>'))]))[0]["status"], "accept")

summary()

cd /workspace && python3 tmp/tests2.py
